notes: Steps: declutter and light staging room by room; book the photographer (usually through the listing agent); shoot in daylight with lights on and blinds open; include exterior, every room, yard and any standout features; approve the final set before it goes on the listing.
prompt: I am Kevin Doud and my house is about to be listed for sale. Give me a room-by-room prep checklist for listing photos (declutter, depersonalize, lighting, what to remove from counters and walls, curb appeal), a shot list the photographer should cover including exterior and yard, the best time of day to shoot, and the five things that most often make listing photos look bad. Finish with a short message I can send the agent or photographer to schedule the shoot this week and confirm I will receive the full photo set to approve before it is published.
title: House: get professional listing photos taken (declutter and stage first, schedule the shoot, approve the photo set)
